title: 3D-Printed Home Can Be Constructed For Under $4,000
summary: A short Insider Tech video on New Story and ICON building 3D-printed homes that can go up in under 24 hours for around $4,000. It frames the effort as a way to address global homelessness.
why: Cited as a concrete example that 3D-printed houses already exist and are cheap.

quote.text: These guys are building small houses with a thing that prints in layers just like a home 3D printer, using mortar instead of plastic.
